patterns: APPSC repeatedly asks one fact: red soil covers the largest area of AP (~66%) - asked in 8+ recruitment papers with near-identical wording.

Other recurring AP items: deltaic alluvium = most fertile / most important for agriculture in K-G deltas; laterite ~1%, acidic, poor fertility; skeletal soils on eroded hill slopes; black soil = Regur/Vertisols.
Trap statements: 'laterite formed in semi-arid low rainfall' (incorrect); very deep black soils in north-western Deccan.
APPSC uses short A-R and 'which are correct' items about AP soil distribution (Nallamala skeletal soils, laterite for horticulture).
App adds agro-climatic zone, scheme and survey-percentage detail (22 categories, SMWSIPDCL) well beyond what APPSC has asked.
